source_priority_policy.principle: This catalog lists x86_64 AppImages only. No .deb, .rpm, Flatpak, Snap, tarball, bare binary, Windows installer or zipped/tarred AppImage is listed. Upstream-built AppImages are tier 1; an AppImage built by a third party is listed only when the project's own website links to it (tier 5). Third-party wrappers around a single remote website are excluded until the schema defines a web-wrapper class.
source_priority_policy.selection: Entries are ordered by rank (1 = strongest recommendation): practical usefulness to XXRI users first, then maintenance activity, availability of a real x86_64 AppImage, upstream reputation, compatibility evidence and category coverage. Apps that duplicate another entry's job were dropped unless they serve a clearly different audience.

verification_methodology.summary: Every entry was checked in two independent ways on 2026-10-25, and the two must not be confused with an install test.
verification_methodology.research_verification: The release, version, asset name and size come from the upstream release API (GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg) or the project's official download page, read live during research. Archived projects, releases older than October 2024 and projects whose newest stable release dropped the AppImage were excluded.
verification_methodology.byte_level_verification: Each download_url was fetched with HTTP Range requests: the first 4 KiB (ELF header: class, e_machine, AppImage magic) and the bytes at the payload offset that xxri-app computes from the ELF section headers (squashfs superblock and compressor, DwarFS or ISO 9660 signature). Full files were not downloaded except where a server ignored Range. The result is in each source's live_check.
verification_methodology.checksum_policy: checksum holds a SHA-256 only when one is known to match the exact file: the GitHub asset digest, a .sha256 published beside the file, or a hash computed here from a complete download (stated in the note). Files that upstream replaces in place have no pinned checksum.
verification_methodology.not_tested: No entry has been installed or launched on XXRI yet. A URL answering a Range request does not prove the app runs on XXRI.
verification_methodology.icon_policy: icon_url points at the project's own repository or website wherever one exists. When none exists, the AppImageHub copy of the icon extracted from the upstream AppImage, a Flathub appstream render, or the vendor's GitHub organisation avatar is used, and icon_note says which. Every icon was fetched, checked as real PNG or SVG data and reviewed visually on light cards.
verification_methodology.research_status_values: fully_verified: current official (or officially linked) x86_64 AppImage found and its bytes checked this session.

research_queue_not_yet_verified: Inkscape - official x86_64 AppImage is published at inkscape.org, but inkscape.org refused connections from the research host on 2026-10-25, so the current file could not be byte-verified. Add once verified.
Msty, Kiro, Xmind, Cinelerra-GG - vendor pages render downloads client-side; no versioned AppImage URL could be pinned and verified.
Electron sandbox and host library coverage - Electron AppImages rely on host NSS, GTK3, libgbm, libasound and libdrm; confirm XXRI x64 ships them before relying on any entry.

schema_notes.proprietary: Proposed extension. true for closed-source applications.
schema_notes.upstream_repository: Proposed extension. Source repository URL; null for closed-source applications.

schema_notes.last_verified: Proposed extension. Date the download and icon were last checked.
schema_notes.compatibility: Proposed extension. Object with the measured payload format, squashfs compressor, AppImage type, whether xxri-app's kernel loop-mount can open it, and any glibc minimum known from the build name or AppImageHub.
